name: Sentinel (Copernicus)
best_known_for: Europe's flagship Earth-observation programme — Sentinel-1 (C-band SAR), Sentinel-2 (multispectral imaging), Sentinel-3 (ocean + land), Sentinel-5P (atmospheric); free + open data policy
credit: ESA / European Commission Copernicus programme. Series 1-6 covers radar imaging, optical imaging, ocean monitoring, atmospheric chemistry, and altimetry.
